description: Queue a future planting for a bed as part of a succession plan — it is NOT yet sown (use add_planting for something the user already planted). Use when the user wants to plan ahead, e.g. "plan to plant more carrots in Bed 2 on August 15".

displayName.description: What to call this planting, e.g. 'Fall Carrots'.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

name: add_planned_planting
title: Plan a planting
